decisions.reason: The online customer portal represents a visible and likely costly process investment tied to customer relationships, so management would tend to justify and continue it unless clear failure becomes undeniable.
This packaging display solution has both public visibility and a strong positive signal from the 2024 German Packaging Award, which strongly reinforces continued commitment.
The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display sits close to the firm’s core display business and has its own webpage, making it a publicly backed offering that management is likely to retain.

Although a small counter display is probably easier to replace than larger flagship items, its dedicated presentation and fit with the firm’s established cardboard display activities support continued commitment.

The large freestanding cardboard information display is a visible extension of the firm’s main business, and management would likely interpret any early weakness as temporary rather than reverse course quickly.
